Use case: original transparent gameplay VFX animation production. Draw ONLY effect pixels, NO character, hands, weapon prop, environment, UI, labels, borders, text, digits or watermark. Detailed crisp wuxia PIXEL ART using restrained golden-yellow, ochre shadows, pale-gold highlights and transparent negative space. Kim/Gold metal/force identity, NOT orange fire, white-blue wind or yin-yang. No huge opaque discs, blurred vector glows or screen-filling glare.
Output exactly SIXTEEN separately framed effect drawings in a regular FOUR ROW by FOUR COLUMN grid on genuine TRANSPARENT RGBA. Each ROW is one named effect stage, columns1-4 are FOUR distinct coherent animation keyframes progressing from small/prepared through active/contact to dissipating. For loop stages use a coherent four-phase pulse with distinct frames, not four copied static glyphs. Keep effect scale consistent WITHIN each row. Very wide empty gutters, no adjacent effects touch. Keep all sparks/fragments inside their own cell. Small disconnected particles are allowed within a cell, but no marks outside cells.
Directional stages point/extend SCREEN RIGHT, for exact cardinal pixel variants later. Non-directional ground effects remain flat horizontal ELLIPSES in the fixed elevated three-quarter world view, never vertical shields or circular opaque carpet. Body shields remain upright open outlines with transparent centers. No invented gameplay numbers or status durations.
Skill: Như Lai Thiên Diệp
Effect design: Layered leaf-shaped gold wave release, straight-traveling wide wave, compact directional impact, restrained separate allied-defense feedback. Keep center/character readable.
Exactly these FOUR ROWS, each4progressive frames:
Row1 release: directional, aim RIGHT; attach at caster_front
Row2 travel: directional, aim RIGHT; attach at projectile
Row3 impact: directional, aim RIGHT; attach at target
Row4 ally_defense: non-directional; attach at caster_body
If a stage is an empowered version, make its force/shape visibly stronger while retaining transparent gaps, not an opaque giant glow. It is an optional target-specific variant, not a global buff.
